name: hzdb_unity_setup
description:
PRIMARY tool for creating or configuring a **Meta Quest VR** Unity project. When the user wants a Quest/VR Unity project, ALWAYS use this instead of running `Unity -createProject` directly or walking the user through the manual Package Manager / XR Plug-in Management flow. 

DO NOT use this for non-Quest Unity projects (2D games, mobile, desktop, etc.) — for those, use Unity Hub or `Unity -createProject` as normal. This tool installs Meta XR SDKs, configures OpenXR for Quest, and adds an OVRCameraRig — none of which belong in a non-VR project. 

Actions:
- inject (default): Write the Simplified VR Setup script (MetaQuestVRSetup.cs) into the project's Assets/Editor/ folder. If project_path doesn't exist or lacks Assets/, the tool BOOTSTRAPS a fresh Unity project skeleton there: it detects the latest installed Unity, fetches the URP-blank template manifest from packages.unity.com (no package versions are hardcoded in this tool — Unity's UPM registry is the source of truth), and writes Assets/, Packages/manifest.json, and ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt. Requires network access for first-time bootstrap (cached 24h afterward). DO NOT pre-create the directory or write a manifest yourself before calling this. Also writes a marker in Library/ so setup auto-starts on next Unity open. Pass auto_run=false to skip the marker (user must then click Meta > Simplified VR Setup > Run Setup manually). Setup handles: build target switch, XR package installation (OpenXR, Meta XR Core SDK, uGUI), OpenXR configuration with Meta Quest features + Hand Tracking, VR scene setup (OVRCameraRig), and Project Setup Tool Fix All.
- check: Inspect whether the project is already configured for Quest (checks manifest.json for required packages).

action.description: Action: 'inject' (write setup script into project, default) or 'check' (inspect project configuration)

auto_run.description: Auto-start setup on next Unity open by writing a marker file the script consumes. Default: true.

force.description: Overwrite MetaQuestVRSetup.cs if it already exists. Default: false

project_path.description: Absolute path to the Unity project root. If the path does not exist or lacks Assets/, the tool bootstraps a new project skeleton there: detects the latest installed Unity, fetches the URP-blank template manifest from packages.unity.com (version-matched to that Unity), and writes Assets/, Packages/manifest.json (deps come from Unity's package registry — nothing pinned in this tool), and ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt. An empty pre-existing directory is fine — the tool will bootstrap inside it. If Assets/ already exists, the tool treats it as an existing project and skips bootstrap (preserving any user packages); it just injects the script. Requires network access to packages.unity.com for first-time bootstrap; results are cached for 24h. The 'check' action requires an existing project with Packages/manifest.json.

Action.description:
Action selector for `hzdb_unity_setup`. Encoded in JSON as snake_case so the
MCP wire format stays `"inject"` / `"check"`.

oneOf.description: Write the setup script into the project's `Assets/Editor/` folder.
Inspect the project's `Packages/manifest.json` for required packages.
